description: Final diagnostic object at {metrics}; never fill missing counters with zero.

owners.switches_per_op: W1/F1: TaskCtx switch_out + switch_in pair / semantic ops
owners.spawn_ns: W1/L2: accumulated fiber/task creation ns / children
owners.rss_bytes_per_task: W1: touched stack RSS / simultaneously resident tasks
owners.migrations_per_s: W1: started tasks rebound to another worker / measured seconds
owners.refresh_ns: R1/W1: Heap::bind stamp-mismatch branch time / refreshes
owners.lookup_ns_per_op: R5/F1: handle table lookup + generation validation ns / lookups
owners.atomics_per_op: R3/F1: root atomic operations / semantic ops
owners.remote_frees_per_s: R2: completed remote frees / measured seconds
owners.ancestor_depth: F1: cancellation ancestor links visited / checks
owners.rank_contention: F1: failed scope rank CAS / rank updates
owners.object_ops_per_s: F1: operations on the contended logical object / measured seconds
owners.syscall_serialisation: R6: ns waiting for host-call serialization / host calls
owners.key_epoch_wait_ns: R6: accumulated resource-key epoch waits / transitions
owners.independent_file_overlap: R6: fraction of host-call time with >=2 independent file requests executing
owners.extern_ns: R8: dispatch + bounded extern call time / calls
owners.pool_queue_ns: R8: blocking pool queue ns / queued calls
owners.gate_wait_ns: R8: serial package gate wait ns / outer entries
owners.ns_per_op: F1: runtime recording CPU ns / recorded semantic ops
owners.compressed_bytes_per_contended_event: F0/F1: compressed schedule bytes / contended events; exclude payloads/headers
owners.cut_pause_ns: F0/F1: accumulated time sections wait for the cutter
owners.flush_ns_per_prepared_request: F0/F1: durable flush ns / prepared requests
owners.meter_ops_per_s: R4: logical charges + credits / measured seconds
owners.allocations_per_s: R4: runtime allocations while memory-budgeted / measured seconds
owners.speculation_pauses: E1/R4: pauses; add speculation_pauses_<cause> for every allowance/envelope cause
owners.permit_wait_ns: K1: accumulated compute permit acquisition ns / acquisitions; enabled only with worker metrics
owners.latency_p99_ns: F1/K1: per-operation latency histogram p99 (never process durations)

comparison: Recording row: record minus off. Other rows: free minus equal-width tokio. Ratios and instruction verdicts remain per workload, never whole-corpus averages.
